blocks.text: Thermistor garmi se mutaasir hone wala (heat sensitive) resistor hai. Zyada tar thermistors ka temperature coefficient manfi hota hai, yani temperature barhne par un ki resistance kam hoti hai. Musbat temperature coefficient wale thermistors bhi milte hain.

blocks.alt: Thermistor ki do alamatein. Baen: bayzawi khaake mein zigzag resistor, us par tirchha teer oopar baen ki taraf. Daen: dono taraf taaron wala mustateel, us ke aar paar tirchhi lakeer jo neeche baen chhote ufuqi pair par khatam hoti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.33: thermistor ki alamatein (kitab ki Figure 9.33 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Thermistor mein temperature barhne par resistance kyun ghatti hai? Kyun ke barhta temperature charge carriers (electrons ya holes) ko zyada energy deta hai; woh zyada azaadi se chal sakte hain, is liye resistance kam ho jati hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Dhaat (metal) mein garmi se resistance barhti hai kyun ke takraav barhte hain. Thermistor semiconductor hai: garmi se naye free carriers bante hain, aur un ki barhi tadaad ka asar zyada hota hai, is liye resistance ghatti hai.

Thermistors manganese, nickel, cobalt, copper, iron waghaira ke dhaati oxides ke mixture se bane semiconductor ceramic ko zyada pressure mein garam kar ke banaye jate hain. Inhein pasandeeda shaklon mein daba kar zyada temperature par pakaya (bake kiya) jata hai. Mukhtalif qism ke thermistors Fig. 9.34 mein dikhaye gaye hain; yeh beads (daane), rods (salakhen) ya washers ki shakal mein hote hain.

blocks.caption: Thermistor ki qismein
rows: NTC (negative temperature coefficient), sab se aam

blocks.text: Thermistors thermometers aur bijli ke aalaat, jaise air conditioner, refrigerator, heater, microwave oven aur incubator, mein temperature par nazar rakhne ke liye lagaye jate hain.

Zyada manfi temperature coefficient wale thermistors kam temperatures, khaas taur par 10 K ke qareeb, naapne ke liye bohat durust hain: kam temperature par un ki resistance zyada hoti hai, jis se paimaish zyada durust ho jati hai.

Thermistors temperature sensors ke taur par bohat istemal hote hain: yeh temperature ki tabdeeli ko electrical voltage mein badal dete hain, jise phir circuit process karta hai. Maslan gariyon ke engine mein coolant temperature sensor (taake engine had se zyada garam na ho) aur digital thermometers mein.
Thermistors un circuits mein lagaye jate hain jahan temperature ki tabdeeli kaam kharab kar sakti hai, jaise oscillators, battery charge karne wale circuits aur power systems.
Koi aala pehli dafa ON karne par shuru ka bara current (inrush current) aata hai; thermistors is shuru wale current ko mehdood karte hain.

Thermistors voltage divider mein bohat istemal hote hain (Fig. 9.35). Thermistor ka temperature barhne par us ki resistance kam hoti hai, is liye us par voltage ka girna (voltage drop) kam ho jata hai. Nateeja: point B ka potential (earth ke muqable mein) kam ho jata hai, aur yeh tabdeeli B se jure circuit ko chala (trigger kar) sakti hai. Fire alarm mein garam hone par thermistor NOT gate ke input ko low kar deta hai; NOT gate ka output high ho jata hai aur siren ON ho jata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke thermistor garam hone par point B ka potential "barhta" hai. Is circuit mein thermistor B aur earth ke darmiyan hai, is liye us par voltage, yani B ka potential, ghatta hai. Yehi kami NOT gate ka input low karti hai, jaisa kitab aage khud batati hai.

blocks.alt: Cell (+ baen) ek zanjeer ke aar paar: nuqta A, kilo-ohm ke darje ki bari resistance, nuqta B, thermistor aur earth nuqta G. Thermistor ke aar paar meter, aur thermistor ke neeche burner ka shola.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.35 (kitab ki Figure 9.35 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Garmi se thermistor ki resistance ghatti hai, is liye us par voltage, yani B ka potential (G ke muqable mein), kam ho jata hai. Isi kam voltage se NOT gate ka input low, output high hota hai aur siren bajta hai.

blocks.prompt: Temperature barhne par thermistor ki resistance kyun kam hoti hai (short question 9.8)?
blocks.explanation: Thermistor semiconductor ceramic se bana hai. Garam karne se us ke charge carriers ko zyada energy milti hai aur zyada electrons (aur holes) chalne ke liye azaad ho jate hain. Carriers ki barhi tadaad ka asar zyada takraon ke asar se bara hota hai, is liye resistance kam ho jati hai; dhaat mein is ka ulat hota hai.

items: Thermistor: garmi se mutaasir resistor; zyada tar NTC (temperature barhne par resistance ghatti hai kyun ke carriers ko energy milti hai).
Mn, Ni, Co, Cu, Fe ke oxides ke semiconductor ceramic se, beads, rods ya washers ki shakal mein pakaye jate hain.
Istemal: temperature ki paimaish (10 K ke qareeb bhi, engine coolant sensor, digital thermometer), temperature compensation, inrush current rokna, voltage divider (NOT gate wala fire alarm).
